title: Strongly continuous and locally equicontinuous families of operators and their relation to bi-continuity
summary: We study strongly continuous and locally equicontinuous families of operators on sequentially complete Hausdorff locally convex spaces. In case of Saks spaces, we relate the general notions to bi-continuity as well as equitightness. In this way, we recover and also generalise known results for special classes of operator families such as bi-continuous ($C$-)semigroups and ($C$-)cosine families by well-known results for the corresponding families in Hausdorff locally convex spaces.
